data: cached B1/B2 states of attempt 3 (bench-results/b3-l1-v3-20261012/states.npz, sha256 df80c17b7eaaa01adf0c8690b8a343f65818d67e55e71644cd68f6208dc587d2), same 600 rows, same 5 paired seeds and fit/select/test splits, private view only
status: EXPLORATORY re-analysis of data already seen by attempt 3. It can explain the FAIL; it can never produce a canon L1 PASS. Any PASS-like diagnostic result only licenses a new confirmatory attempt on fresh data (new data seed) with its own preregistration.

hypotheses.H1_bytes: The byte term is not the cause: |cost(LATENT 64 B) - cost(SYMBOLIC)| < 0.005 utility, smaller than every observed accuracy gap.
hypotheses.H2_head_asymmetry: Canon LATENT is scored through a FROZEN NO_MESSAGE readout plus a message-only residual (B3-H2), while EXACT/SYMBOLIC/SYMBOLIC_ATTR/CONTROL get a jointly REFIT head on [receiver state, feature]. Tasks escalate/apologize need the receiver-private threshold re-weighted once the sender quantity is known. Test: LATENT_REFIT = same trained bridge message (BF16, unchanged encoder) with a refit head exactly like the baselines; and SYMBOLIC_ATTR_RESID / SCALAR_RESID = baselines forced through the same frozen-head residual. H2 is supported if LATENT_REFIT - LATENT >= 3 points on >= 2 of 3 tasks, or if the residual constraint costs the baselines >= 3 points on >= 2 of 3 tasks.
hypotheses.H3_supervision: The bridge only sees one binary/ternary task label on 360 items, while SYMBOLIC_ATTR/SCALAR use privileged U/F labels. Test: linear probe R^2 of U and F (ridge, fit split -> test split) from the bridge message Z vs from sender PCA-16 pooled state. H3 is supported if R^2(Z) < R^2(sender PCA-16) - 0.1 for the quantity the task depends on.
hypotheses.H4_ceiling: ORACLE_UF (true U, F as two numbers, refit head) bounds what any message about the sender can add; reported per task.

diagnostic_gate: l1_gate is additionally evaluated with LATENT := LATENT_REFIT (SYMBOLIC = label word, and = attribute words, as in attempt 3). Reported as 'diagnostic', never as canon verdict; no bridge manifest is written, B3_LATENT stays unavailable, runtime unchanged.
